messages.text: I’m checking a barrel candidate with compact90 mm sensors while retaining the existing sixteen-sector envelope and48-layer depth. The assessment will cover board packing, shared services, cooling and support interfaces.

A modular candidate fits inside the retained envelope: seven1 m panels and two shorter end panels per sector/layer. A panel centred at the interaction point avoids a barrel-wide seam at z=0. Compact square sensors suffice; the remaining losses come from board gaps, interface bays, end reservations and sector edges.

**BARREL-SysArch — independent, read-only handoff.** Scientific input revision: `5664d16aea2df36222dc0099ba18594cf506304d`; governing workflow: `7c6d453fef12c3207b468c4fc99633fb393072a4`. The generic assignment explicitly applied the SysArch mandate; native profile loading was not verified.

**The refined modular candidate fits the retained envelope geometrically.** It uses intact square silicon and rectangular PCBs, with separate carriers, cooling and interface bays. PCB routing, mounts, headers and mechanical qualification remain open.

Retain16 sectors,48 layers, front apothem1700 mm,10.9 mm pitch, barrel half-length3900 mm,20 mm end reservation/flanges and10 mm back cover. Thus sampling ends2223.2 mm, cover2233.2 mm, HCAL begins2263.2 mm; flange ends3920 mm, leaving30 mm to the3950 mm endcap. [Pinned DES029](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/5664d16aea2df36222dc0099ba18594cf506304d/docs/design/DES-029-calorimeter-assemblies.md), [assembly constants](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/5664d16aea2df36222dc0099ba18594cf506304d/tools/calorimeter_hardware/assemblies.json).

Use local coordinates `(t,a,d)` = tangential, axial, outward radial. For sector angleφ and layer front`r_l=1700+10.9l`, global placement is:
`x=(r_l+d)cosφ−t sinφ`, `y=(r_l+d)sinφ+t cosφ`, `z=a`. This is right-handed.

For negative panels, outward`u` points toward−z; use a proper in-plane rotation, preserving outward radial orientation. The central panel’s bay is at+z: active placement remains z-symmetric, passive services are explicitly asymmetric.

The tangential board bound is `|t|≤(r_l+1.9+0.93)tan(pi/16)−41 mm`, retaining the40 mm side allocation plus1 mm half-seam. Usable widths run595.428–799.234 mm; the smallest remaining PCB clearance is **1.440 mm**.

The short-panel correction resolves a real constraint: centred three-row PCBs end at143 mm, overlapping a141–181 mm bay by2 mm. Moving their grid5 mm inward reduces that edge to138 mm, leaving **3 mm** clearance and preserving the5 mm frame. Full panels have24 mm PCB-to-bay clearance.

Copy the PR70 radial hardware stack after the1.9 mm tungsten: skin0–0.2; Si0.35–0.85; PCB0.93–2.53; ASIC glue/package/graphite/post2.53–4.80; common Cu4.80–7.80; rear skin7.80–8.00 mm. The remaining1 mm gives10.9 mm layer pitch. Four10×12 mm packages at local±22 mm fit each full board. Shared packages use the inherited interface thermal stack. [Pinned PR70 hardware construction, lines39–76](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/5664d16aea2df36222dc0099ba18594cf506304d/tools/calorimeter_hardware/edge_export.py#L39).

The CALICE paper supports intact90 mm sensors, embedded ASICs and compact slab-end readout as architectural precedents; its40×180 mm SL-board is documented on PDF6. It does not qualify these new94 mm boards or continuous barrel cooling. [CALICE primary paper, §§3–3.1, PDF4–6](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2211.07457).

Full panels contain9 boards per lane. Group complete lanes as3+3,3+3+1 or3+3+2 for6/7/8 columns: **2/3/3 interfaces**, each≤8192 channels. Each short panel needs one interface. Derived totals are359904 sensors,92135424 channels and15648 interfaces; inherited power hypotheses give **188.40 kW** and **9.01 kg/s** ideal water flow at5 K rise. These are calculations, not thermal qualification.

Remaining interface constraints:

- **CaloTech↔SysArch:** absorber ownership stays once per sector/layer. Independent readout panels must not duplicate tungsten. Continuous7.8 m absorber manufacture/load paths remain unqualified; physical segmentation would need explicit joints/material accounting.
- **CaloTech↔services owner:** axial2 mm-OD tubes at`t=0,±250 mm` fit the3 mm Cu plate. Subtract pipe holes, exclude end-frame bands from plates/skins, and measure tube setbacks from actual plate boundaries.
- **Headers remain absent.** Side/end allocations still contain tungsten or aluminium. Radial collectors crossing48 layers need explicit ports or another reserved route. No empty-air corridor, connector fit, hydraulic network or external routing is established.
- **CaloTech↔SoftEng:** up to552 boards per sector/layer fit the10-bit module field. Full-square local masks can reuse EdgeGrid; mechanical panels should not replace individual board IDs.

No custom silicon is necessary for this candidate. Short carriers use ordinary full sensors. Residual strips, guards,120–146 mm active gaps between panel groups, service bays and sector seams remain visible. Crucially, centred6/8-column grids leave an8 mm active gap at sector-centreφ: **eta0,φ at a sector centre crosses only22/48 active layers**. This requires explicit reporting or a separately assessed staggering alternative; it is not acceptance.

Actual checks: pinned-source inspection, public-paper reading and independent standard-library slot, corner, bay, symmetry, count and power calculations. The refined bay checks passed; active positions are exactly z-symmetric and extend to|z|3829 mm. **No native construction, overlaps, mass/material scans, transport or engineering checks were run. No files changed.** Root should validate actual frames/plates/ports, inherited IDs, native mass/material and directional seam/service crossings before claiming an implemented prototype.
